text.checkText: Seen on the floor: confirmed with data or ruled out, and the result written next to the cause

tips: Write the effect as a fact.
"Routes leave the dock late", with the number if you have it. Not "bad loading": a judgement hides the causes.
Fill the bones with the team.
The people who do the work know the causes. Ten minutes at the board beat an hour at the desk.
A sub-cause is the answer to "why does this happen?". One level is enough here; deeper goes to 5 Whys.
Vote, then mark what is likely.
Each person gets three votes. The causes with the most votes are the ones to check first, not the ones to fix first.
A likely cause is a guess until someone has seen it on the floor. Each one becomes an action to verify, with an owner and a date.
